Entries.Title: Ski into Love
Entries.Description: Dan Chong helps his sister, Dan Shan, to buy a 2nd-hand drawing tablet online. He and the seller arrange to meet at Nancheng's Anime Carnival for the trade. Wu Man Man replaces Wi Zhi as Azhai for the book-signing event held there. Dan Chong helps his sister to acquire the signature of Azhai. He accidentally finds out that the seller of the drawing tablet is actually Wei Zhi, whom he met at the subway by coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Desire to Create
Episodes.Description: Dan Chong helps his sister, Dan Shan, to buy a 2nd-hand drawing tablet online. He and the seller arrange to meet at Nancheng's Anime Carnival for the trade. Wu Man Man replaces Wi Zhi as Azhai for the book-signing event held there. Dan Chong helps his sister to acquire the signature of Azhai. He accidentally finds out that the seller of the drawing tablet is actually Wei Zhi, whom he met at the subway by coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Snowboarding Pro
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets the main character of the snowboarding promotional video who made her heart flutter at the convention. She also becomes elated after receiving a piece of goggle cloth from him. However, Wei Zhi doesn't realize that the pro is Shan Chong.

Episodes.Title: Her Own Story
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi sits alone by the slopes and watches the video of Shan Chong and Dai Duo to search for inspiration for her work. Wei Zhi begins to fall in love with snowboarding.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Comic Contest
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi finds out about the original snow sports comic drawing contest. She decides to join it. She invites Shan Chong to join her as a character in her comic.

Episodes.Title: Battle
Episodes.Description: Yan and Bei Ci go to Wantong Academy to argue with K. Shan Chong agrees to face K at the terrain park in a tricks battle.

Episodes.Title: The Real Him
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets up with Shan Shan. She is shocked when she finds out that Shan Chong is her older brother.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Wang Xin, Shan Chong's snowboarding coach, tries to persuade him to return to the national team, causing them to think about his retirement after getting injured five years ago.

Episodes.Title: Pursuing Dreams
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi wants to continue her career in comics. So, she musters up her courage to find Da Xiang and invite Da Xiang to join her studio.

Episodes.Title: Return to Xicheng
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi pleads with her mother to let her go to Xicheng Ski Resort for research, but Mrs. Wei urges her to give up her comic career and marry Jiang Yi Ming as soon as possible.

Episodes.Title: Love Rivals
Episodes.Description: Jiang Nan Feng wants to find Wei Zhi at Xicheng. When Wei Zhi goes to the airport to pick her up, she finds out that Jiang Yi Ming has come to Xicheng together with his sister.

Episodes.Title: Heartfelt Conversations
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong sends a drunk Wei Zhi back to the hotel. Both of them have a heartfelt conversation in the hotel room. Shan Chong asks Wei Zhi about her relationship with Jiang Yi Ming.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Gem
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi, Shan Chong, and the group travel to Lezhou. After dinner, Yan and Bei Ci ask Jiang Yi Ming about his relationship with Wei Zhi. After overhearing their conversation, Shan Chong goes to find Wei Zhi and tells her he wants to take her to a place.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong tells Wei Zhi his story. At night, both of them squeeze into a sleeping bag intimately.

Episodes.Title: Promise of Return
Episodes.Description: The coach invites Shan Chong to return to the national team again. Shan Chong agrees to it. He states that he'll return to the team once he saves enough money to buy Shan Shan a pair of prosthetics.

Episodes.Title: Visiting the Shan Family
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong brings Wei Zhi home to see his parents. He tells them his plan to get prosthetic limbs fitted for Shan Shan, and that the attending physician, Jiang Yi Ming, is Wei Zhi's childhood friend. Shan Chong's parents express their gratitude to Wei Zhi.

Episodes.Title: Exposed Relationship
Episodes.Description: Dai Duo sends Shan Shan home but both are reluctant to say goodbye to each other. Their relationship is exposed when Wei Zhi and Shan Chong catch them kissing.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Up
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi's mother belittles Shan Chong with her words. Shan Chong thinks that he cannot provide Wei Zhi with a dependable future as of yet. He breaks up with Wei Zhi.

Episodes.Title: Perseverance and Courage
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets with Wu Man Man and asks her whether she is facing creative burnout and pressure from Wang Lao Hu. Drawing from her own experiences, Wei Zhi encourages Wu Man Man.

Episodes.Title: Rewrite the Ending
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi invites Wu Man Man to the studio. Everyone gathers at Wei Zhi's studio to complete the finale of Farewell Song together.

Episodes.Title: Returning to the National Team
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong tells his parents that he has decided to return to the national team. His parents support his decision.

Episodes.Title: A Long-Awaited Reunion
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi travels to Xicheng for an inspiration searching trip, with the first stop being a visit to the national snowboarding training center. She sees Shan Chong again after a long time apart.

Episodes.Title: Deemed Worthy
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi reconciles with Shan Chong. They decide to split up and persuade Wei Zhi's father and mother respectively to agree to their relationship.

Episodes.Title: A Promised Future
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong and Dai Duo reach the finals in the Men's Snowboard Big Air event. Wei Zhi and the gang go there to support them.

Entries.Title: Secrets Happened on the Litchi Island
Entries.Description: My brother's classmate became my roommate.

Episodes.Title: Licorice Wax Apple
Episodes.Description: My brother's classmate became my roommate.

Episodes.Title: Wild Fun by the Pool
Episodes.Description: Love is a pool that never dries up, and every frame of light is a kiss that travels through time.

Episodes.Title: Deep Sea Night Fire
Episodes.Description: Our gaze missed each other in the night fire, like a cold deep sea that can never ignite flames.

Episodes.Title: Existence and Birds
Episodes.Description: The first heartwarming moment of the summer camp was when we were honest and had a deep conversation about the topic of existence and birds.

Episodes.Title: Sudden Summer Rain
Episodes.Description: That summer, the island covered in lychee trees was as lively as a child's. The happiness I gained on the island was not just a little bit, it had the taste of lychee ice honey, the aroma of fruit wood roasted chicken, and the sweetness and astringency of youth. Unfortunately, the lychee tree that year did not bloom, let alone bear any fruit.

Episodes.Title: Dreamlike Stroll in the Garden
Episodes.Description: You are the best in your world.

Episodes.Title: Surging Undertow
Episodes.Description: After counting 1, 2, and 3, we are heading towards happiness. Xiao zhi and Chen Li will always be happy and sweet.

Episodes.Title: Wearing? Not wearing！Is this the wedding music video?

Entries.Title: The Blossoming Love
Entries.Description: A crack has appeared in the Immortal Formation's barrier. Xie Xue Chen gives it his all to protect the formation. However, the leaders of Dark Tribe work together to attack him.

Episodes.Title: The Underworld
Episodes.Description: A crack has appeared in the Immortal Formation's barrier. Xie Xue Chen gives it his all to protect the formation. However, the leaders of Dark Tribe work together to attack him.

Episodes.Title: Illusion
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling tries to rescue Xie Xue Chen. Yu Ying reprimands her for betraying the Underworld.

Episodes.Title: A Bigger Threat
Episodes.Description: Knowing there's a spy in the Xian Alliance, Xie Xue Chen uses Nan Xu Yue's teleportation array to return to Yongxue City to investigate.

Episodes.Title: The Hiding Place
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling and Xie Xue Chen squabbles. Each vying to fight against Zhan Ying. Nan Xu Yue shows up and uses his formation to put Zhan Ying's projection clone away...

Episodes.Title: Spy
Episodes.Description:
Yan Si is no match for Xie Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling, so she flees in panic. Gao Qiu Min summons all the disciples of Jinghua Palace to conduct an

investigation.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Su Ning Zhen takes out Zai Xi. But in an instant, dark aura breaks out from her face and blood patterns seem to surface. Everything seems to be getting out of control. Xie Xue Chen and the other four take on Su Ning Zhen and Zai Xi. But it's getting tougher to hold them back.

Episodes.Title: Reconcile with Father
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen and the others activate the teleportation array to head Yongxue City, only to discover toward that someone has planted a killing spell.

Episodes.Title: The Past Promise
Episodes.Description: Nan Xu Yue sees what Mu Xuan Ling has done for Xie Xue Chen. He can't help but ask her if she remembers the promise she once made to him.

Episodes.Title: Lure the Snake Out of Its Hole
Episodes.Description: The Xian Alliance convenes in the Zhengqi Court, where Xie Xue Chen highlights the pressing need to elect the new Alliance Leader. As proposals are heard, everyone harbors their own thoughts.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen can't bear to see Mu Xuan Ling suffer from the Speech Spell. He transfers the injury to himself.

Episodes.Title: Succession Ceremony
Episodes.Description: At the start of the new Alliance Leader's succession ceremony, Xie Xue Chen accompanies The Venerable Fajian to the Tower to break the seal. The Venerable Fajian, eager to escort the Pearl of Chaos back to Xuantian Gate, is halted by Xie Xue Chen.

Episodes.Title: The Secret
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling's demonic aura is showing on her face and she reaches out to grab Gao Qiu Min by the neck...

Episodes.Title: Dispersing Demonic Powers
Episodes.Description: The three sect leaders of Xian Alliance discuss executing Mu Xuan Ling. However, Xie Xue Chen can't bring himself to do so. Gao Qiu Min pleads for Mu Xuan Ling too.

Episodes.Title: Ice Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen and Xuan Xin guard the Jewel Tower. Xie Xue Chen has a bad hunch and feels that something bad is about to happen.

Episodes.Title: Severing Love Ties
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen abandons Mu Xuan Ling to save the people...

Episodes.Title: Nominating the Alliance Leader
Episodes.Description: Sang Qi summons Mu Xuan Ling to Zhushen palace. Mu Xuan Ling behaves like a totally different person.

Episodes.Title: Cage of Greed
Episodes.Description: Xie Dao Cheng reveals that Mu Xuan Ling is Xie Xue Chen's desire and inner demon. Then he orders Xie Xue Chen to kill Mu Xuan Ling.

Episodes.Title: Bond in Blood
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling and Gao Qiu Min find out by accident that they are actually related.

Episodes.Title: The Truth from Back Then
Episodes.Description: Under Sang Qi's intense questioning, Su Ning Zhen has no choice but to divulge the truth from back then.

Episodes.Title: The Resting Place
Episodes.Description: Sang Qi loses the will to keep fighting. He leaves in search of Su Ning Xi's tomb, hoping to bring her home.

Episodes.Title: The Search for Eternal Life Lotus
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling arrive at The Waterless Domain and discover the Eternal Life Lotus, only to be abruptly stopped by Fengxiang.

Episodes.Title: The Price to Pay
Episodes.Description: Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling try to get to the Eternal Life Lotus. Fengxiang reppears but she doesn't seem to remember what had happened yeserday.

Episodes.Title: Confession of the Heart
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen brings Mu Xuan Ling back to the city, where Mu Xuan Ling explains to Nan Xu Yue that her previous actions were influenced by the Heart Perception, as her heart has always been set on Xie Xue Chen.

Episodes.Title: The Only Kin
Episodes.Description:
Xie Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling rush to the Immortal Formation's barrier. Mu Xuan Ling decides to enter the Underworld to convince Sang Qi to stop

the Dark Tribe's strange movement.

Episodes.Title: Emerging from the Illusion
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen saves Mu Xuan Ling from the Blood Formation. He finally meets the Fallen Immortal face to face. But what he sees is a face identical to his own.

Episodes.Title: Entering the Underworld
Episodes.Description: He Xian Wo mistakes Gao Qiu Min for the Pearl of Chaos and brings her to the Underworld. Xie Xue Chen, Mu Xuan Ling, and Fu Lan Sheng head to the Underworld to save her.

Episodes.Title: Reviving a Life
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen heads to Qifeng Forest in hopes of finding a way to save Mu Xuan Ling. He takes the Eternal Life Lotus and meets Superior Immortal Lunjing.

Episodes.Title: Back to the Past
Episodes.Description: Xie Xue Chen travels back in time and immediately heads to the Mount Realms to stop He Xian Wo.

Episodes.Title: Saving Mu Xuanling
Episodes.Description: At Mingyue Mountain Manor, the servants try to make young Mu Xuan Ling die in Gao Qiu Min's stead. Xie Xue Chen hurries there to save her.

Episodes.Title: Wedding
Episodes.Description: Nan Xu Yue forces a marriage with Mu Xuan Ling. During the ceremony, she transforms the Chaos Power into a blade and stabs it into Nan Xu Yue's chest. He does not evade and expresses his willingness to let Mu Xuan Ling vent her anger.

Episodes.Title: The Mortal Tribe's emotions
Episodes.Description: Zhao Ming asked Divine Providence to teach Zhu how to read and write. Zhu can sense that she has annoyed Divine Providence, so she bakes some pastries as an apology. This makes Divine Providence ponder over the mortals' emotions.

Episodes.Title: Leading the Charge
Episodes.Description: The three gods incite chaos in the mortal world, compelling every state to turn their spears and draw their swords against Dongze. Zhao Ming has no choice but to lead the charge.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Divine Providence tells Zhu to return to the Divine Domain to relieve the suffering of love, but she refuses. Divine Providence is enraged. Deep down, he has made his choice.

Episodes.Title: Flippant Human Nature
Episodes.Description: Qing Yang performs a dance at the birthday banquet but suddenly tries to assassinate Zhao Ming. The attempt fails and she's imprisoned. Zhu witnesses this and recalls Divine Providence's second bet, 'flippant human nature, betrayal of friends and family!

Episodes.Title: Qiankun Bead
Episodes.Description: The Divine Providence grants Zhu the Qiankun Bead. Zhu decides to activate it, transferring any future harm that might befall Zhao Ming onto herself.

Episodes.Title: Powers Sealed Off
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling rushes to Zhengqi Court to stop the Demon King. She exchanges her Chaos Power for the safety of all mortals.

Episodes.Title: Risking Her Life to Save His
Episodes.Description: Chi Ying transforms Dark Wood Seal into a sharp blade as instructed by Nan Xu Yue. He then shoots it at Demon King's heart. At the moment of great danger, Mu Xuan Ling takes the stab for Demon King.

Episodes.Title: The Final Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Qian Guang persuades Fengxiang to give up immortality. He asks her along to see the world and the people.

Episodes.Title: Defending Together
Episodes.Description: The Demon King breaks the Jade Threshold Restriction and his demonic aura overflows. Nan Xu Yue uses the Mantra of Destiny to hold him back but that is exactly what the Demon King wants.

Episodes.Title: The Heavenly Will
Episodes.Description: Mu Xuan Ling is afraid that the Demon King will be tempted by the Heavenly Will. Nan Xu Yue says that the blind spot lies outside the space-time they are in. The two of them are totally helpless.

Filter
Entries.Description: Su Chengcheng attended the interview at the Marketing Department of Vandai Cosmetics Company, but was directly eliminated by the interviewer because of her appearance.

Episodes.Title: Magic Bracelet
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng attended the interview at the Marketing Department of Vandai Cosmetics Company, but was directly eliminated by the interviewer because of her appearance.

Episodes.Title: New Idea
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng walked home and met her parents. Su Chengcheng called out to her parents, but they didn't recognize her at all.

Episodes.Title: Lies
Episodes.Description: In order to dispel Tang Qi's entanglement with Su Miao, Su Chengcheng, who turned into Su Miao, deliberately made a fool of herself at the dinner table to annoy Tang Qi. However, Tang Qi became more appreciative of Su Miao because of her bravery to show her true self in front of others.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Night
Episodes.Description: After the company dinner, Lin Yuan drove to pick up Su Chengcheng, but Gu Yu got into the car first. Su Chengcheng had no choice but to send the drunk Tang Qi home.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi learned from Gu Yu that Su Miao was at Lin Yuan's house. So he went to Lin's house to invite Su Miao to dinner dating, hoping to formally confess his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Crisis of Exposing True Identity
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi came to the hospital to visit Su Miao, but the Filter was upgrading. As the truth was about to be exposed, Su Chengcheng tried to escape.

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Plan
Episodes.Description: Su Miao invited Tang Qi to meet by the lake. Tang Qi came, but he didn't know that Su Chengcheng's perfect plan is waiting for him.

Episodes.Title: His Secret
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng transformed into Su Miao's alpaca and entered Tang Qi's house. Tang Qi spoke with Alpaca from the bottom of his heart, allowing Su Chengcheng to know Tang Qi's secret.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Improved
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng wanted to compensate Tang Qi in her own way. However, Tang Qi was disappointed with Su Chengcheng as a subordinate, so he was indifferent to her kindness.

Episodes.Title: Having Feelings For Her Again
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng used Fang Jin's name to ask Tang Qi for a meeting. In the cafe, Tang Qi watched 'Fang Jin' interacting with the waiter and was moved by her cuteness and friendly attitude.

Episodes.Title: Uncontrollable Now Playing Attraction
Episodes.Description: Guan Shengyu wanted to sell the patent to another company. Tang Qi tried to avoid 'Fang Jin', but he had to discuss countermeasures with her. 'Fang Jin' proposed a wise plan, and this made Tang Qi uncontrollably attracted by her.

Episodes.Title: Misunderstanding
Episodes.Description: In order to get rid of Guan Shengyu, Su Chengcheng lied that she was dating Tang Qi. Guan Shengyu was not convinced and said it is impossible for Tang Qi to love a woman with such unattractive appearance. Unexpectedly, Tang Qi hugged Su Chengcheng and praised her for her beauty. Su Chengcheng was shocked.

Episodes.Title: Strange Feelings
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi went to the laboratory to find Fang Jin. At this time, Su Chengcheng, who was stuck in the image of 'Fang Jin', was studying the new products with the real Fang Jin in the laboratory.

Episodes.Title: Two 'Fang Jin'
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng transformed into 'Fang Jin', and Tang Qi confessed to her. 'Fang Jin' fled in panic. Tang Qi met the real Fang Jin and asked for her reply. From the reaction of the real Fang Jin, Tang Qi finally confirmed there were two 'Fang Jin'.

Episodes.Title: Her New Boyfriend
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi kept sending messages to 'Fang Jin', trying to find out the truth. Su Chengcheng came up with a plan to make Tang Qi give up.

Episodes.Title: The Only One Shining With Colours
Episodes.Description: After 'Fang Jin' disappeared, Tang Qi suddenly lost colour vision, and was unable to recognize traffic lights. Strangely, he found that he could only see colours on Su Chengcheng.

Episodes.Title: Retrieving Colours
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi decided to tell Su Chengcheng about his eyes, hoping to ask for her help to find out the reason for his loss of colour vsion.

Episodes.Title: A Familiar Stranger
Episodes.Description: Gu Yu suggested Quan Shengtang to attend the Qixi Festival event as the model of Lin Yuan's comics. Su Chengcheng and Lin Yuan checked into the inn reserved by the company and found that Quan Shengtang had to share the room with Tang Qi.

Episodes.Title: Close Contact
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi told Su Chengcheng that he could regain colours when he had close contact with her. Su Chengcheng kissed Tang Qi, and successfully restored his eyes to normal.

Episodes.Title: Hallucination
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi and Quan Shengtang drove back to the city. In the thunderstorm, the Filter flickered, Su Chengcheng changed her face in front of Tang Qi.

Episodes.Title: Verifying His Guess
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi discovered that the bloodstains of Quan Shengtang on his cuffs were fake. He went to the police station to look for Quan Shengtang's information, but found that there was no such person. Tang Qi already had the answer in his mind.

Episodes.Title: A Flawless Trap
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi set up a trap for Su Chengcheng at his home, waiting for her to come and expose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Uncover the Truth
Episodes.Description:
Tang Qi told the truth - Su Miao, Fang Jin and Quan Shengtang are actually fabricated by Su Chengcheng! Su Chengcheng sincerely apologized and

explained how she had been deceiving him using various identities.

Episodes.Title: Confession Rejected
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi confessed to Su Chengcheng, but Su Chengcheng thought he was teasing her and said she only wanted to maintain an ordinary colleague relationship with him.

Episodes.Title: Safe Haven
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi confessed again, and Chengcheng finally accepted his love.

Episodes.Title: Secret Love
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng didn't want to make their relationship public in office. Tang Qi was unhappy with her attitude.

Episodes.Title: Malfunction
Episodes.Description: The Filter started to malfunction and change Su Chengcheng's appearance randomly. Su Chengcheng's parents asked her to take Tang Qi home for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Old
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi and Su Chengcheng investigated the old lady who gave Su Chengcheng the Filter. Eventually, they found that she had passed away long ago.

Episodes.Title: Invisible Human
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng told her parents the truth about the Filter Bracelet, and she began to live as an invisible human.

Episodes.Title: Keeping Lin Yuan's Secret
Episodes.Description: Lin Yuan was pregnant but she want to tell Gu Yu. She asked Chengcheng to keep it secret.

Episodes.Title: Telling the Truth
Episodes.Description: Su Qingli misunderstood that Su Chengcheng was pregnant. The Su family gathered and demanded Tang Qi and Su Chengcheng to get married immediately.

Episodes.Title: Propose to Her Again
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi felt regret that Su Chengcheng was invisible when he proposed to her. So he prepared a ring and planned to propose again.

Entries.Title: Reborn
Entries.Description: In the summer of 2007, 17-year-old Qiao Qingyu moved with her family from Shunyun to Huanzhou to start a new life.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's Younger Sister
Episodes.Description: In the summer of 2007, 17-year-old Qiao Qingyu moved with her family from Shunyun to Huanzhou to start a new life.

Episodes.Title: Words Can Kill
Episodes.Description: Qingyu insisted that Beiyu died of appendicitis. Ming Sheng said that his father was the director of the hospital where Beiyu stayed in, implying that he could know the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Clues in Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and her family returned to Nanqiao Village to visit their grandparents. Qingyu examined the traces that Beiyu left in the house, trying to know more about Beiyu.

Episodes.Title: Lies or Truth
Episodes.Description: Ms. Xiu Zhen told Qingyu that she didn't know why Beiyu died, but Beiyu had a miscarriage. Beiyu refused to tell who the father of the child was until her death.

Episodes.Title: Boyfriend from Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: Qingyu learned that rumors about her sister were not spread by Ming Sheng. She began to change her mind about Ming Sheng.

Episodes.Title: The Rumored Beiyu
Episodes.Description: He Fei Hai recalled his memory of Beiyu. At first, Beiyu fought back against bullying. But gradually, She became just like the rumors said.

Episodes.Title: The Call from Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: With the help of Wang Mumu, Qingyu escaped from Hei's entanglement. Hei then went to Qiao's Noodle House instead.

Episodes.Title: You Have Me
Episodes.Description: Qingyu delivered food to the building opposite to her, and found that Ming Sheng lived there. In order to repay Ming Sheng's protection, Qingyu helped him tidy up his room.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Music Box
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and her family returned to Nanqiao Village to celebrate the New Year and attended Jinrui's wedding. Qingyu was curious when she saw the dancing doll hanging in Jinrui's car.

Episodes.Title: Never to Be Forgotten
Episodes.Description: In front of the grave of Beiyu, Qingyu promised to make the ones who hurt Beiyu pay the price. Qingyu wrote a letter to reveal Jinrui's fault and prepared to distribute it on the wedding day.

Episodes.Title: The Broken Wedding
Episodes.Description: Qingyu attended Jinrui's wedding. When it was time to distribute candy, Qingyu put the candy box at the venue and left.

Episodes.Title: Where You Go, I Go
Episodes.Description: Qingyu gave her lucky charm to Ming Sheng as a gratitude for allowing her stay in his house. Ming Sheng gave Qingyu a gift in return.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Is Beautiful Tonight
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng and Qingyu made a pinky promise to leave Huanzhou together. But Qingyu had already decided to leave alone.

Episodes.Title: Running Out of Courage
Episodes.Description: Qiao Lusheng insisted on taking Qingyu to Nanqiao Village to apologize for her mistakes. Li Fanghao strongly opposed it, but Qingyu expressed her willingness to do so.

Episodes.Title: Meet You At the Tree
Episodes.Description: Qingyu sneaked out to meet Ming Sheng under the big tree. The two agreed to return to their normal lives without interfering each other anymore.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's Wish
Episodes.Description: Before Jinrui left Huanzhou, he came to the school to say goodbye to Qing Yu. He returned Beiyu's music box to Qingyu, hoping that she could fulfill Beiyu’s wish.

Episodes.Title: Every Family Has Its Troubles
Episodes.Description: Wang Mumu accidentally fell down the stairs due to violence from her father. Mumu’s ankle was injured, causing her unable to perform on stage. Qingyu arrived in time to help, and hence fulfilled her own dream of dancing.

Episodes.Title: I Lied. I Have an Umbrella
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng ran into Qingyu in the hospital and told her that he was going to study medicine in France. In the rain, Ming Sheng suggested to lend Qingyu an umbrella, but Qingyu refused because they will never meet again.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's DV
Episodes.Description: Doctor Le Fan recalled Beiyu's story to Qingyu, and Qingyu realized that Beiyu did not die of AIDS, but committed suicide by jumping into the sea.

Episodes.Title: Li Fanghao's Outburst
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and the family returned to Nanqiao Village to keep vigil for her grandfather. Qingyu's uncle and aunt made things difficult for them. Li Fanghao could not bear it anymore and slapped Qingyu's aunt.

Episodes.Title: I'm Glad We Met
Episodes.Description: After the dance competition, Qingyu and Ming Sheng spent a wonderful time together in amusement park. They played with fireworks sticks at the beach, and Qingyu made three wishes.

Episodes.Title: I'll Remember You Forever
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng is preparing to go to Beining for the overseas study examination. At the same time, Qingyu is preparing for the college entrance examination.

Episodes.Title: I'll Always Be Here When You Turn Back
Episodes.Description: Qingyu spent a colorful college life. Mumu told Qingyu that Ming Sheng had returned to China. Qingyu sent a message to Ming Sheng, but received no reply.
